svg.title: The prettier-svg-docs diagram-type catalog — 27 types
svg.desc: A contact sheet of 27 animated diagram-type specimens in alphabetical order, two to a row. Every cell is that type's own full-width specimen scaled down, so each carries its real layout, connector routing and label geometry rather than a flattened imitation. All are drawn in the flat-material style, so the variable across the sheet is the type and nothing else.
svg.text: 27 layout grammars, one style — the type is the variable
